designationHistory.indexText: Big Boggy National Wildlife Refuge About Us What We Do Law Enforcement Laws & Regulations Contact Us Visit Us Activities Get Involved News Species Map About Us Established in 1983, Big Boggy National Wildlife Refuge is primarily salt marsh salt marsh Salt marshes are found in tidal areas near the coast, where freshwater mixes with saltwater.
